instances.name: Payments Hub
instances.description: The bank's payment initiation platform: captures instructions from channels, validates and authorises them, and hands them to execution.

instances.name: Instruction Capture
instances.description: Receives payment instructions from channels and creates the instruction record.

instances.name: Instruction Validation
instances.description: Checks instructions against limits, mandates and sanctions lists; records authorisation.

instances.name: Execution Gateway
instances.description: Hands authorised instructions to scheme execution and tracks execution references.

instances.name: Payment Initiation Service
instances.description: The externally exposed payment-initiation behaviour of the hub.

instances.name: Create payment instruction
instances.description: Creates a payment instruction from the customer's details.

instances.name: Validate payment instruction
instances.description: Runs validation and records the authorisation outcome.

instances.name: Get payment instruction
instances.description: Returns the instruction and its status. NOTE: implemented as POST for legacy channel reasons.

instances.name: Amend payment instruction
instances.description: Amends amount, date or creditor before execution.

instances.name: List payment instruction events
instances.description: Returns the event history of an instruction.

instances.description: Published when an instruction changes state.
